name: ROBOTIS RH-P12-RN(A)
mpn: RH-P12-RN / RH-P12-RN(A) (firmware variant); UR kit RH-P12-RN-UR 905-0028-000
description: Two-finger adaptive robot hand with passive finger joints and a DYNAMIXEL-P-compatible RS-485 actuator, current (force) controllable.

specs.label: Stroke
specs.value: 0–109 mm (e-Manual); 0–106 mm on units shipped from 4 Nov 2019 (robotis.us)

specs.label: Interface
specs.value: RS-485 multidrop, DYNAMIXEL Protocol 2.0, 9600 bps–10.5 Mbps; 12-bit absolute encoder

specs.label: Power
specs.value: 24 V nominal; 30 mA standby, 3.33 A peak

envelope.axes: x = finger opening direction (open), y = depth, z = height from base underside to fingertip (drawing RH-P12-RN, 2020-02-21)

features.label: Stroke / finger travel
features.value: 109 mm (106 mm with post-Nov-2019 fingertips); fingertip pads 20 mm tall, 36 mm from tip to linkage

features.label: Base mounting taps
features.value: 12× M3 tapped holes, 6 per side on the base boss, 3 mm above the bottom face, 6 mm from edge, spanning 36 mm (option frames/UR mounting frame attach here)

features.label: Face taps
features.value: 8× M3 tapped (4 per front/back face): trapezoid with 24 mm (upper) and 32 mm (lower) spacing, 42 mm vertical

features.label: Fingertip mount
features.value: 3× M3×6 bolts per finger (6 total); finger mount 26 × 21.9 mm, holes 14 mm apart (7 mm from centerline), 10 mm / 3 mm offsets

features.label: Top
features.value: 2× M2.5 tap on top, 22 mm apart

features.label: Mounting interface
features.value: No ISO flange on the hand itself; ROBOTIS option frames or the UR mounting frame (RH-P12-RN-UR kit, for UR e-Series ISO 9409-1-50-4-M6 tool flange, M6×8 screws included) bolt to the M3 taps

features.label: DOF / actuators
features.value: 1 actuator (DYNAMIXEL-type), 2 fingers with passive adaptive joints

features.label: Connectors
features.value: RS-485: JST B4B-EH-A (GND, VDD, D+, D−); external port Molex 53047-0610 (GND, VDD, 4 I/O)

notes: The official 3D meshes are very low-poly (496 triangles for the base, 'PR24A03_HAND_ASSY'), so they're only good for collision/visual stand-ins. The exact 3D model should be rebuilt from RH-P12-RN.pdf or the DWG, or ask ROBOTIS for the STEP. Stroke conflict: e-Manual says 109 mm, robotis.us says 106 mm after the Nov 2019 fingertip change. RH-P12-RN and RH-P12-RN(A) are the same hardware with different firmware. The drawing is marked 'for reference only'. No Amazon listing found; sold by robotis.us, RobotShop and Generation Robots.
